main.description: An assertion that a set of flights belonged to one journey. Only 'createdAt' is required, and absent means unknown or not applicable. The reference points one way only, from trip to flight, and a trip references only flight records the author wrote.

createdAt.description: When this record was written, not when the trip happened. Explicit UTC offset, no fractional seconds.

name.description: Free-text name for the trip. Public and permanent once published.

flights.description: The flights in this trip, in the order flown, as AT-URIs to flight records. Plain AT-URIs rather than strong references, since flight records are corrected in place. References may dangle; readers must tolerate that.

source.description: Short identifier for the tool that wrote this record.

sourceId.description: That tool's own identifier for this trip. A grouping key may be sensitive even when the grouping is not: never write a booking reference here.
